visualCharacteristics: Photo on the left ~3/4, solid dark-blue title panel with diagonal line graphic on the right ~1/4; title not overlaid on the photo.
contentPattern: Banner photo with page title on a blue lined panel. Prominent page-top banner combining a photo and the page title. The decorative lines PNG is styling and is dropped (recreated in CSS).
usage: Page-top banner on section landing pages (e.g. /about): one banner photo and the page title (h1), optionally a subheading and CTA.
reuseGuidance: Use when the title sits in its own panel beside the photo. For a title overlaid on a full-bleed image use the base hero block.
